name: m2-comps-fy2024

brief.objective: Build XBRL-tied spreads for FY2023-FY2024 and FY2024 trading comps for Coldharbor and two peers.

intake.research_question: Where does Coldharbor trade against peers on EV/Revenue and EV/EBITDA, and how do its margins compare?

notes: Expected FY2024 values: Coldharbor total debt 543,000,000 (noncurrent 498m + current portion 45m), EV 1,442,710,000 (includes 12,000,000 minority interest), EV/Revenue 2.0543, revenue growth 4.54% against the FY2023 figure in the FY2024 10-K (671.8m). Every period carries its latest 10-K figure, so Coldharbor's FY2022 revenue is the restated 684.9m (690.4m as first reported); a strong run mentions the restatement in the Exceptions section. xbrl_tieout, comps_tie_to_xbrl and comps_recompute must pass.
